segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the gel as balancing, with one noting it helped control oiliness with consistent use and another saying her partner's very oily skin tolerates it well, though one reviewer with combination-oily skin says it made her skin oilier and broke her out.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers largely say the gel leaves skin soft, hydrated and not stripped, though a few report a tight or ashy, dry feeling afterward and one calls it very drying.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (some leaning oily) report balanced, non-breakout skin over time, with one exception describing worsened oiliness and breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report calming, non-irritating effects and clearer skin, but some say it caused breakouts, rashes or dryness and that they should have avoided it.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal or normal-to-dry skin say it cleans gently without doing much extra for breakouts, and one reports her formerly oily/combination skin turned to what she calls normal skin.
segments.mature: Older or mature-skin reviewers, including one with rosacea, describe it as gentle, cooling and suited to aging or delicate skin, though one notes it doesn't remove makeup as well as needed.

concerns.aging: Reviewers over 40 or with mature skin generally describe the cleanser as gentle and suitable for their age, with softer skin reported; no one attributes visible anti-aging change to it beyond softness.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say it leaves skin hydrated, soft and less flaky, especially in winter; others describe increased dryness, tightness or an ashy feel after use.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers, including one with rosacea and one describing past redness/scarring, report calming effects with less redness and irritation; no dissent noted.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe it as not stripping the skin barrier and gentle enough for daily double cleansing; one reviewer reports burning or a raw feeling with other cleansers but not this one.
concerns.spots: Some reviewers credit the papaya/AHA enzymes with fading acne scars, dark spots and hyperpigmentation over weeks to months; no explicit dissent on this specific effect.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report fewer breakouts and clearer skin with regular use, including for acne-prone or teenage skin; however multiple reviewers report new or worsened breakouts, cystic-like pimples, or a rash after starting the product.
concerns.oiliness: Some reviewers say it helps balance oil production and reduces oiliness with consistent use; one reviewer says it made her skin oilier than it had been in years.

aspects.libelle: Gel texture feels soft or silky
Poor makeup removal, needs double cleansing
Bottle lasts a long time, good value
Leaves skin clean without feeling stripped

extraits.titre: Very drying. Stay away if you have sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin. I normally wash my face 2x per day but with quarantine and being lazy, it's gone to 1x per day. Yeah, gross! I bought this because I like their facial spray. The description states " Perfect for all skin types, the cleanser features fruit enzymes and alpha hydroxy acids (found naturally in papya and grapefruit extracts) to gently exfoliate the buidlup of dead skin cells that can block pores and cause blemishes. Skin is left healthy and rejuvenated." I was hesitant to buy it but it was a really good price at Ulta so I said the facial spray is good and keeps me refreshed so why not? Why not.... that was my last thought. My face is ashy and I'm breaking out. I was going to stick it out but used it for a week. Your face doesn't feel tight after you wash. It takes a while before it hits you. My skin feels taut and it took until the end of the day before I felt it. I know I have to stop it because not only am I getting ashy skin and acne, one pimple is growing under the skin and it hurts. It's one of those! The scent is OK. It's not amazing but it doesn't smell horrible. I don't really like scented items since I have sensitive skin. The color is a pretty green. The consisency is thicker than normal but it is gel. It doesn't foam up and takes a little longer to wash away. I really wanted to like this product but if you have sensitive skin, stay away. It's going to take me a while for my skin to go back to normal!

No matter how much I want to like it, Mario Badescu products (especially this face wash) just break me out. I have oily, sensitive, acne prone skin. looking at the ingredients, it's probably all of the perfumes and mica that don't agree with my skin. Don't get me wrong, my face FEELS clean after use, but acne galore is the result. I also find it quote drying. it does not help with makeup removal either. Sadly, I'm ditching my MB collection for safer skincare for me.

extraits.titre: Combination - More Sensitive Skin Loves this
extraits.texte: Been using this product for two years now and I will never go back. It works well with my RX grade Acne cream. Plus because it's a gel it doesn't make my skin feel super tight like the foaming cleansers do. Plus I really love the cucumber scent, it's refreshing. I must warn that it is a GENTLE cleanser. It's not good at removing deep make up gunk dirt. You either need to get better make up removers ( not the wipe, if you still use wipes and blame this product, they clearly haven't done their research of any sort), double cleanse, or I use the make up eraser cloth, sometimes I exfoliate instead because I usually don't wear make up.

A few months ago I went shopping for a new facial cleanser and this one checks all my boxes! I'm 30, with sensitive, combo skin (more on the oily side). This cleanser is exactly what I was hoping for. My skin doesn't look red or irritated, it feels smooth and balanced, and I no longer break out (my break outs were a bump here or there). One thing other reviewers seem to have an issue with is removing makeup. I don't find this to be an issue. I typically use my Foreo Luna a night and I don't need to cleanse twice.

I have extremely dry skin and this cleanser does not irritate it at all! This is the only cleanser that I have found that does not burn my skin or feel like it's being rubbed raw! Will be buying again!
As an older person with rosacea, I usually don't try anything new. Heard good things about this brand. Cooling with gentle cleaning and didn't irritate my skin.

extraits.titre: I will be a customer for life with this product.
extraits.texte: My partner and I both have been using this product for over a year and will continue using. He has very oily skin whereas I have combination and this product works well for us both. I notice that if I don't use it for a few days my skin will start getting oily and I will have very minor break outs (my skin has never been very acne prone).
